title.it: Modelli cloud ricontrollati sulle pagine ufficiali: Gemini 4, GPT-6.2 e Grok 4.20
title.en: Cloud models rechecked against official pages: Gemini 4, GPT-6.2 and Grok 4.20
title.fr: Modèles cloud revérifiés sur les pages officielles : Gemini 4, GPT-6.2 et Grok 4.20
title.es: Modelos en la nube revisados en las páginas oficiales: Gemini 4, GPT-6.2 y Grok 4.20

features.it: Gemini propone la famiglia 4 (Carbon, Neon, Hydrogen, Argon) e la prima configurazione usa Hydrogen e Neon; OpenAI propone GPT-6.2 Astra e Sol; xAI aggiunge Grok 4.20.
features.en: Gemini offers the 4 family (Carbon, Neon, Hydrogen, Argon) and first setup uses Hydrogen and Neon; OpenAI offers GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol; xAI adds Grok 4.20.
features.fr: Gemini propose la famille 4 (Carbon, Neon, Hydrogen, Argon) et la première configuration utilise Hydrogen et Neon ; OpenAI propose GPT-6.2 Astra et Sol ; xAI ajoute Grok 4.20.
features.es: Gemini ofrece la familia 4 (Carbon, Neon, Hydrogen, Argon) y la primera configuración usa Hydrogen y Neon; OpenAI ofrece GPT-6.2 Astra y Sol; xAI añade Grok 4.20.

fixes.it: Tolti dagli elenchi i modelli superati o non più documentati (Gemini 3.6 Flash e 3.1 Pro, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.5, Mistral Medium e alias -latest) e i vecchi Grok passano da soli a Grok 4.7.
fixes.en: Removed superseded or no longer documented models from the lists (Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.1 Pro, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.5, Mistral Medium and -latest aliases) and old Grok models move to Grok 4.7 automatically.
fixes.fr: Retrait des modèles dépassés ou plus documentés (Gemini 3.6 Flash et 3.1 Pro, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.5, Mistral Medium et alias -latest) et les anciens Grok passent automatiquement à Grok 4.7.
fixes.es: Quitados de las listas los modelos superados o ya no documentados (Gemini 3.6 Flash y 3.1 Pro, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.5, Mistral Medium y alias -latest) y los Grok antiguos pasan solos a Grok 4.7.
